As evidence, he mentioned the outfit of the #o9409017#s. #p9000072# said that he can no longer put up with the #r#o9409017#s#k walking around in their revealing underwear and asked that you eliminate them. 0.0: How could this be?! How could this have happened in the #m950100000#? This is all because of #p9000078#, whose idea was to develop #m950100000# into a tourist attraction. Look at all those tourists who've come at his beckoning! What? You want to know what I'm talking about?
0.1: All those tourists are corrupting the morals and culture of the holy #m950100000#! I have evidence... Just take a look at the outfit of those #o9409017#s! They are so vulgar... I can't stand looking at them! Something must be done now!

yes.0: Oh, so you'll help? It's good to know that there are some sensible ones even amongst the outsiders... In that case, I won't refuse your help. Please go defeat #r200#k of those lewd #r#o9409017#s#k! You can get to the Goblin Cave by talking to #b#p9000075##k!

no.0: Fine. I guess I better tell #p9000078# to stop allowing tourists to enter. Then I'll have to deal with the #o9409017#s myself!

1.0: Oh! It looks you've returned from eliminating the #o9409017#s! Thanks to you, the town seems to have somewhat returned to normalcy.

yes.0: But those #o9409017#s are so persistent that they will probably return to normal once an hour has passed. I would like to ask the same favor of you again at that time. Please come back to me after #b1 hour#k has passed.

mob.0: Have you not defeated the #r200 #o9409017#s#ks yet? Then again, it must be pretty hard to do while looking at their vulgar outfits... Still, this is a very important matter. Please talk to #b#p9000075##k and enter the Goblin Cave.
